slices.focus: Getting a small restricted budget for barcode labels, archival folders, and part-time data entry after six months of persistence
slices.summary: After six months of sample counts and follow-ups, Hannah finally gets a modest restricted budget for barcode labels, archival folders, and part-time data entry focused on active loan-file cleanup — framed not as modernization but as loan risk reduction.
open_loops: Draft one-page scope defining what the temp worker is allowed to touch
Define 'complete enough to trust' for active loan files
Specify where barcode labels get used first (mandatory vs optional)
Include retrieval time as a success metric
decisions: Hannah remains registrar and won a small budget to expand her collections integrity project for barcodes, archival folde
